## 2. Per-pull VRF and keeper cost vs the maintenance allocation

## 5. Genesis farming equilibrium (sim/farming.py market model; 25M farm, 2 % fee)

Loss per pull = fee + settlement + VRF share (10-pull batch, 0.01 gwei) - expected backing + 0.00002 ETH wallet gas. Farmer loss over 14 days equals the ETH their ENGINE realises (identical across configs for a given outside-buying level); the configs differ in how many pulls that loss buys and where the ETH goes. 14-day totals in ETH.
